Flexible sigmoidoscopy report

Patient: Quinn Abernathy (fictional)
Synthetic record: SYN-GI-3012
Date of service: 2026-10-21
Place of service: 11 office
Endoscopist: Dr. Noor Haddad, MD (fictional)

Procedure
Flexible sigmoidoscopy with cold snare polypectomy.

Indications
Intermittent hematochezia in a 34-year-old; evaluate for a distal source.

Technique
Two enemas were given before the examination. The sigmoidoscope was inserted and advanced to 40 cm from the anal verge without difficulty. No sedation was used.

Findings
Grade I internal hemorrhoids.
A 5 mm sessile polyp in the sigmoid colon at 25 cm was removed with a cold snare and retrieved.
The examined mucosa was otherwise normal.

Impression
Internal hemorrhoids, likely source of bleeding. Sigmoid polyp removed.

Recommendations
Await pathology. High-fiber diet.
